name: Genomics
summary: Studying whole genomes: sequencing technologies, assembly, annotation, comparative genomics and genome function at scale.

topics.name: Genome anatomy: genes, repeats, non-coding DNA and genome size (C-value paradox)
Sanger sequencing and the Human Genome Project
Long-read sequencing: PacBio and nanopore; telomere-to-telomere genomes
Genome annotation: gene prediction and functional annotation
Genetic variation: SNPs, indels, structural and copy-number variants
Comparative genomics, synteny and conserved elements
Genome evolution: gene duplication, horizontal gene transfer and whole-genome duplication
Functional genomics: genome-wide screens, ENCODE and regulatory element maps
